name: Cryptid Companions
source:
As the broke blogger for Cryptid Compass, you take the cryptozoology business very seriously. With a little help from your ghost guide Lynn, you'll embark on a journey across the globe to meet three cryptids, who might not be exactly how you expected... Learn about their tragic pasts and work to uplift them. Or not. The choice is yours. 

[From [url=https://mattpiedragames.itch.io/cryptid-companions]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为《Cryptid Compass》的破产博主，你非常重视神秘动物学业务。在幽灵向导林恩的帮助下，你将踏上穿越全球的旅程，去见三个神秘生物，他们可能与你想象的不一样……了解他们悲惨的过去，并努力让他们振作起来。或不。选择权在你。

[来自[url=https://mattpiedragames.itch.io/cryptid-companions]Itch.io[/url]]
